title: Maths GCSE Teacher, SEMH Provision
summary: Teach GCSE and Functional Skills maths in a trauma-informed SEMH provision with classes of no more than six.
body:
## The position

We're recruiting on behalf of an independent specialist education provider for a maths GCSE teacher to join a small SEMH provision in Nottinghamshire. The role starts on a fixed-term basis, with a clear view to becoming permanent for the right candidate.

## About the setting

The setting supports children and young people with SEMH needs alongside associated diagnoses such as autism (ASD), ADHD, foetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD), sensory processing difficulties, attachment needs, and mild to moderate learning needs.

Classes are small, typically no more than six pupils, with teaching assistants and additional one-to-one support where needed. The provision is structured and trauma-informed, with consistency, relationships and pupil wellbeing at its heart.

## What you'll need

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS).
- A degree-level qualification or equivalent.
- Experience teaching GCSE Maths and/or Functional Skills Maths.
- Experience working with pupils with SEMH needs.
- Strong behaviour management skills and a trauma-informed approach.
- A commitment to professional development.
- Willingness to undergo an enhanced DBS check.

## What's on offer

- Excellent daily rates.
- An initial fixed-term contract with a view to permanent.
- Term-time-only working.
- Small class sizes and high staff-to-pupil ratios.
- A supportive specialist setting.
- Ongoing professional development.
